description: This file defines a GSource-based adapter for integrating hiredis asynchronous Redis client with GLib's main event loop, including functions for managing read/write events and creating new source instances.

methods.name: redis_source_add_read
methods.description: Enables read events on the RedisSource poll_fd and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_del_read
methods.description: Disables read events on the RedisSource poll_fd and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_add_write
methods.description: Enables write events on the RedisSource poll_fd and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_del_write
methods.description: Disables write events on the RedisSource poll_fd and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_cleanup
methods.description: Removes read/write events and poll_fd from the RedisSource, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: redis_source_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the RedisSource for polling, setting timeout and checking event flags.

methods.name: redis_source_check
methods.description: Checks if the RedisSource has any revents set indicating activity.

methods.name: redis_source_dispatch
methods.description: Handles I/O events, calling redisAsyncHandleRead/write as appropriate, and invokes callback.

methods.name: redis_source_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the RedisSource, removing poll_fd from the main loop.

methods.name: redis_source_new
methods.description: Creates a new RedisSource instance associated with a redisAsyncContext.
